hero.lede: Game and low-level programmer. I build the code that has to be fast and exact: rollback netcode, game engines and distributed storage.
hero.intro: I spent more than four years on Idol Showdown at Besto Games. Now I work on distributed block storage at AWS, and I’m open to new work and consulting.
meter.summary: My career as a frame meter, one cell per month since January 2012: the United States Air Force from 2012 to 2018, Butte College and Fisher College from 2018 to 2023, Besto Games from 2020 to 2025, and AWS from 2025 to now.
work.title: Work
idol.alt: Idol Showdown: two fighters trade hits in front of a torii gate on a bamboo shrine stage.
idol.p1: A free, fan-made hololive fighting game with rollback netcode. It has more than 1.2 million downloads and a 9/10 rating on Steam.
idol.p2: As a systems programmer at Besto Games I built input handling on SDL and the Wwise audio integration, worked on the UI, wrote debugging and tracking tools inside the Unity Editor, and made a bug tracker that sent designers’ reports straight into our CI/CD pipeline.
bestonet.caption: The last five frames ran on a guess of the other player’s input. When their real input for the first of those frames arrives, the game rewinds to the last confirmed frame and re-simulates all five before drawing the next one.
bestonet.p1: Open-source rollback netcode for Unity, written in C# for Idol Showdown. It replaced the game’s GGPO integration to get rid of relay latency and multi-frame rollback bugs.
bestonet.p2: I worked on speculative frame saving, input prediction, keeping both peers’ clocks in step, and a 7-frame input buffer that rides out lost and out-of-order packets.
games.title: Smaller games
games.foxtales: An NES-style platformer in the spirit of DuckTales, made as a birthday project for Shirakami Fubuki. With MasterJonald, 2026.
games.baubau: A FuwaMoco platformer about breaking out of confinement. With Poppysicle, 2024.
games.lightless: A stealth horror puzzle game: a princess escapes her captor after her hero abandons her. With Nullctipus and Gogibahp, 2023.
games.carrot: A small grid puzzle starring a bunny. With Gogibahp, Poppysicle and Saitooo, 2022.
tools.title: Engines and tools
tools.bestoengine: A 2D engine on MonoGame with ECS and 2D physics, built around a deterministic core: a fixed-tick loop, rollback state hooks and a fixed-point math library.
tools.unityhelpers: Helper classes and systems I reuse across Unity projects.
tools.in_progress: Groundwork, my own 2D engine in C# on Vulkan, and a farm defense game I’m building on it with friends.
experience.title: Experience
jobs.aws.name: Amazon Web Services
jobs.aws.role: Software development engineer, Elastic Block Store
jobs.aws.desc: I work on the EBS Durability Engine in C++. I designed a metadata sync pipeline for replication across availability zones, moved intent deletion off the write path into async garbage collection, built the metrics and alerting for the B-Tree Clone rollout, and tracked down flaky integration tests caused by memory-safety bugs and races.
jobs.besto.desc: I built input, audio, UI and editor tools for a fighting game with 1.2 million downloads, and worked on its rollback netcode.
jobs.butte.degree: A.S. in Social and Behavioral Science
jobs.usaf.name: United States Air Force
jobs.usaf.desc: I processed performance reports for 4,100 people and handled more than $32,000 a week in special pay inquiries. I earned the Air Force Achievement Medal and was picked from 500+ candidates to train and mentor 180 university students at Maxwell Air Force Base.
